days.topic: Introduction to TDM and its capabilities
days.desc: Importance of test data in testing, COTS product overview, partnership, Cog IPs, TDM architecture.

days.topic: Introduction to TDM data discovery / data profiling
days.desc: PHI/PII data, GDPR/HIPAA regulatory, sensitive data identification, data profiling, policies and rules.
Data subset, importance of data subset, types of subset, driver tables.
Data obfuscation, data masking, transformations, masking algorithms (substitution, shuffle, key masking, encryption).

days.topic: Test data classification; test data generation
days.desc: Generate test data using the Informatica ILM tool; understand data generation in Informatica ILM TDM.
Data generation: model, design, deploy, manage.
Boundary conditions data, sequential, random, edge cases, null.
Identify TDG use cases, POC, assessment on application/data environment, TDG deployment plan.

days.topic: Working on a data generation TDM scenario
days.desc: Hands-on: generate 50 records with FirstName, LastName, Full Name (FirstName MiddleName LastName) and Phone Number.

days.topic: Primary key basics and discovery; (hands-on) primary key discovery using Delphix
days.desc: Primary key; data integrity maintained in primary and foreign key columns. Create a connector to a VDB from the Delphix masking engine.
Create connections; perform data profiling in Delphix.
Perform data masking in files (txt, dat).

days.topic: Working with masking rules in sample scenarios
days.desc: Masking rules, masking algorithms, mapplet creation, using transformations.

days.topic: End-to-end data masking plan development (high level)
days.desc: Identify test data masking use cases, analyse the technology landscape, POC, assessment on a particular LOB, sign-off.

days.topic: Working on a data masking TDM scenario, Day 1
Working on a data masking TDM scenario, Day 2
days.desc: Use other masking rules and mask alphanumeric text, SSN and telephone number.

days.topic: Final project evaluation + final technical evaluation
days.desc: Deliverables of the final project are evaluated by the BU SME.
